set.body:
Conditional on the JavaFX feasibility gate passing, turn the spike into surface-view-javafx. Separate a toolkit-free compiler/program from the JavaFX Application Thread interpreter, following the existing graphics-javafx boundary. Cache TriangleMesh, normals, face-to-atlas mappings, materials, PixelBuffers, and chunked MeshViews by stable render-plan resource key. Implement exact dirty classification for camera, style, layer-data, geometry, and disposal changes; batch pixel writes and issue one updateBuffer notification per affected atlas.

Provide explicit LitAnatomical and UnlitScientific material modes, SCENE3D/depth/antialias capability diagnostics, deterministic snapshot configuration, resource disposal, context/toolkit failure errors, and host hooks without owning Stage/Application lifecycle.

Acceptance: toolkit-free command tests, live JavaFX integration tests, reference-renderer differential images, bounded atlas memory, no stale resources after layer/surface removal, no application-thread violations, documented capability fallback, and surfaceViewJavafxJVM/test passing warning-clean.
set.title: Production JavaFX surface backend: resources, atlas updates, materials, and snapshots
